prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady walk along a rugged, rocky trail on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The camera moves forward, capturing the uneven terrain composed of loose stones and patches of dry grass under a clear blue sky. As the journey progresses, the path winds slightly uphill, revealing more of the surrounding landscape. The camera pans to the right, showcasing distant snow-capped peaks under the bright sunlight, emphasizing the vastness and isolation of the area. The movement continues along the trail, passing by small clusters of rocks and sparse vegetation, with occasional glimpses of icy patches reflecting the sunlight. The camera angle shifts subtly, maintaining a focus on the path ahead while occasionally tilting upward to capture the towering mountains in the background. The scene remains empty, devoid of any human presence, enhancing the sense of solitude. The natural light casts sharp shadows, highlighting the textures of the rocks and the vibrant blue of the sky, creating a serene yet challenging outdoor environment. The continuous forward motion of the camera provides an immersive experience of navigating this remote and picturesque mountain trail.
